question: In a certain code language, 'JEEP' is written as 'WJHL' and 'CARD' is written as 'KWDE'. How will 'LANE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

According to the English alphabet positional value,

The pattern followed here is :

'JEEP' is written as 'WJHL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/024a943cf24d98b81a07473dd5ce764c56825a7095ef70ad751351949dd5ab65.png] 

And,

'CARD' is written as 'KWDE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/653393e2e00ff23596e60fae7bac242529fa3bbbc4cc9cfb700ea19056404494.png] 

Similarly,

 'LANE' is written as LSDN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49685c2d40cfcf7d49b38f4eae95cbfc17bc0ad40ae429c982e0ead94b559de1.png] 

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the **correct answer.**
